The '''High Councilor''' was the title given to the leader of the [[Neshtovar]], ruling [[council]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh's]] continent [[Keshtah Minor]]. In [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], the High Councilor of the Neshtovar was [[Izri Dazh]].
